::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 25th 1888  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge V 3
:::

Dear [Mr Smith](people/person_1344.qmd)

Here is the [receipt](organizations/other_160.qmd) with many thanks. I ought to have returned Madge Wylie sooner. If of the right length, it would be a grand thing to have a Greek story for the [Christmas number](organizations/other_52.qmd) it would be so much out of the ordinary beat.[^1]  I have three or four come in already, not at all bad ones - but I hope they may still be excelled

Yours sincerely 
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: 'Madge Wylie' is not identified and the Greek story does not seem to have appeared in the Christmas 1888 number of *MP*.
